name: mermaid
note: Same release and hash as the Mac app pin (mac Core/Editor/Mermaid.swift). Hash computed from a one-time download of the exact URL (jsDelivr immutable version path, HTTP 200, no redirect). Bumping the version means updating url, sha256, sha256_base64, bytes and the sha256 source in tauri.conf.json csp together; check-csp.test.mjs fails otherwise.
